narrative.overview: Badi is a calm finding aid for reviewing uncertain Gmail classifications before they become labels. Cool paper surfaces, blue-black ink, ruled dividers, indexed navigation, and named signal colors make evidence and recovery easy to scan.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper ground with ledger-blue review sheets.
Ruled records and indexed navigation instead of anonymous dark cards.
Teal actions, amber verification, quiet green success, and coral consequence.
System sans for work and compact mono for technical values.

rules.name: The Named State Rule
rules.body: Signal color never stands alone; every semantic mark carries readable text.

rules.name: The Review-First Rule
rules.body: The first viewport leads with uncertain messages and a direct Review action; operations support the work rather than replacing it.

dos: Lead with messages that need a human decision.
Keep Gmail as the reading destination and Badi as the review layer.
Preserve keyboard order, screen-reader labels, and touch targets.
Keep the ledger grammar consistent across every route.
donts: Do not reintroduce the incumbent dark dashboard.
Do not use color as the only state indication.
Do not use gradients, glass, or monospace as decoration.
Do not invent mailbox claims or unverified visual assets.
